scope: PHASE 2b B1 (docs/requirements/PHASE2B_DESIGN_SPEC.md §2): complete the Button theme family in Themes/MainTheme.tres (LF, 53-scene shared). Replaces the three pixel ninepatch styleboxes for normal/hover/focus with StyleBoxFlat matching the PHASE 1 pressed/disabled flat language: normal id=42 Surface 2 bg + Normal Border 1px + radius 4 + content margin 10 (static, one step above container); hover id=43 Elevated Surface bg + Highlight Border 1px (one step up, same margins -> no layout jump); focus id=44 transparent bg + Highlight Border (keyboard focus ring drawn over normal). Text colors: normal #E0E0E0 -> Primary Text #E4E9EF, focus green -> Primary, hover green -> Arcane #79D98B (green = interactive). Dead-reference cleanup (M3): remove ext id=8/9 ninepatch_58*.png + sub id=34/38/37 blocks; nothing else references them. DEVATION (mechanism-forced): load_steps stays 32 (v1-hd-cleanup owns the line earlier in the chain; the base-anchored preimage applier cannot express 32->30 because load_steps=32 does not exist in the 04_recovered base; actual sub_resource count after B1 is 30, value is informational only and boot-verified). pressed/disabled (id=40/41) NOT reopened. No new file paths (roundtrip 3744), no gameplay/collision/input changes, no baseline promotion.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: every Button's normal state renders as StyleBoxFlat id=42: bg Surface 2 #121820, border 1px Normal Border #293642, corner radius 4, content margin 10/10/10/10 (identical margins to pressed 10/11/10/9 -> no layout jump between states)
hover state renders as StyleBoxFlat id=43: bg Elevated #1D2731, border Highlight #405365, radius 4, content margin 10/10/10/10; text turns Arcane #79D98B
keyboard focus draws StyleBoxFlat id=44: transparent bg (does not obscure hover), Highlight Border #405365, radius 4; text stays Primary
normal/focus text #E0E0E0/green -> Primary #E4E9EF; hover text green -> Arcane #79D98B; disabled/pressed text untouched
